note: Dispatch ('Central') and car chatter: the main heat cue (CORE_SYSTEMS). Plain-English period style; no real call signs. {placeholders} are filled by Gameplay from the witness description.

lines.text: Central to Midtown Central cars: a report of shots fired, {street} and {avenue}.
Central to Madison Square cars: assault in progress, {street} near {avenue}.
Central to Bryant Park cars: a car theft, {street} and {avenue}. Check it out.
Suspect: {sex}, {build}, {topColor} {top}, last seen {direction} on {street}.
Vehicle: {carColor} {carType}, partial plate {plate}, {direction} on {avenue}.
Witness: {sex}, {topColor} {top}, carrying a {item}. Use caution.
Description's vague, Central. A woman, dark coat. That's all we've got.
Witness says 'a guy'. Just 'a guy'. Thanks, Central.
Witness says he looked like a cop. Walked like a cop. Says he's no cop.
Heavy-set male, expensive suit, grey hair, big black sedan. Real memorable.
Central to all cars: officer down, {street} and {avenue}. All units respond.
Central, we need a second car. Suspect is armed.
Car one-four, canvass the block. Check the doorways and the subway.
Nothing on Eighth, Central. Lot of people. Lot of coats.
Central, we lost him at the station. Too many exits.
Suspect is gone, Central. Resuming patrol.
Central, cancel that. Complainant isn't sure what she saw.
Car eight, never mind that report. Sergeant says it's handled.
Central to all cars: signals dark from Twenty-Sixth to Thirty-Fourth. Watch the crossings.
Central, car six, out of service for coffee. Ten minutes.
Central, any word on overtime? …Never mind.
Central to Midtown Central: hydrant open again, Thirty-Seventh and Ninth.
